story.title: Story 5: Reopen and Degraded Provenance States

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up re-verification focused on SV-05-001 by re-reading the touched client reload path, the new package-member navigation test, the existing review workspace/package server behavior for unavailable members, and rerunning the story and epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `selectPackageMember()` now routes `PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` and `REVIEW_TARGET_NOT_FOUND` through `reloadReviewWorkspaceSelection()` instead of immediately setting a fatal workspace error (`apps/platform/client/app/bootstrap.ts:1348-1385`). The new client test exercises a stale member 404 followed by a workspace reload and asserts the workspace stays open instead of falling into the generic failure state (`tests/service/client/package-member-nav.test.ts:288-361`). That aligns with the existing server/bootstrap evidence that degraded package members remain visible within the workspace rather than collapsing the whole package (`tests/integration/review-workspace.test.ts:868-901`; `apps/platform/server/routes/review.ts:393-410`).

mockOrShimAuditFindings: No material production-path mocks/shims were introduced in the touched surfaces; mocked fetch, fake auth, and in-memory fixtures remain confined to test code.
additionalObservations: The prior blocker is closed in the production code path: stale package-member follow-up reads now use the same bounded workspace-reload recovery pattern as stale artifact-version reads.
The new client test proves the no-collapse fallback path; the exact degraded package workspace shape remains primarily evidenced by the existing server/integration review tests.
`verify-all` still ends with the scaffold-only `test:e2e` skip message, but the command completed successfully.
